actionable_proposals.description: Best 2026 paper key insight: calibration is separable from accuracy. Add CalibratedClassifierCV(method='isotonic', cv=3) post-processing to evaluate_individual() in features/engine.py and political_engine.py.

from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
cal = CalibratedClassifierCV(model, method='isotonic', cv=3)
cal.fit(X_val, y_val)
y_pred = cal.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
